description: SEM Studio bootstrap reference: set.seed(seed, kind = 'Mersenne-Twister', normal.kind = 'Inversion', sample.kind = 'Rejection'); for b in 1..B: idx = sample.int(n, n, replace = TRUE), cSEM::csem() on data[idx, ] with the main fit's options; failed = error / no convergence / non-finite estimate; inadmissible = cSEM::verify(); se = sd(valid), t = est/se, p from t(df = B_valid - 1), CI = quantile(type = 7).
